expressions.en: Could you please send me the report?
expressions.cn: 你能把报告发给我吗？ (Nǐ néng bǎ bàogào fā gěi wǒ ma?)
expressions.bm_formal: Bolehkah tuan/puan hantar laporan tersebut kepada saya?
expressions.bm_casual: Boleh tak hantar report tu kat saya/aku?

expressions.en: I will follow up on this.
expressions.cn: 我会跟进这件事。 (Wǒ huì gēnjìn zhè jiàn shì.)
expressions.bm_formal: Saya akan membuat susulan mengenai perkara ini.

expressions.cn: 我们安排个会议吧。 (Wǒmen ānpái gè huìyì ba.)
你能澄清一下这一点吗？ (Nǐ néng chéngqīng yīxià zhè yī diǎn ma?)
expressions.bm_formal: Bolehkah tuan/puan jelaskan lebih lanjut mengenai perkara ini?

expressions.cn: 我会在周五前完成。 (Wǒ huì zài zhōuwǔ qián wánchéng.)
expressions.bm_formal: Saya akan siapkan menjelang hari Jumaat.

work.scenario: A project manager needs an updated status report from a team member by end of day. The team member also needs clarification on a specific task before proceeding.
key_phrases: Bolehkah tuan/puan hantar laporan tersebut kepada saya?
Bolehkah tuan/puan jelaskan lebih lanjut mengenai perkara ini?
Saya akan siapkan menjelang hari Jumaat.

life.scenario: Two friends are coordinating to organize a potluck dinner. One friend needs to confirm who's bringing what, and they need to set a time to finalize details.
key_phrases: Boleh tak hantar list makanan tu kat aku?

tech.scenario: A user is experiencing a software bug and contacts technical support. The support agent needs to understand the issue and commit to a resolution timeline.
